description: Honest evidence map linking PR3 catalog scenarios (AU..OP) and cross-role flows (F01..F36) strictly to existing on-disk test files that execute and assert them.

AU-001.note: Verified landing renders without leaking private orders in Playwright smoke.

AU-005.note: OTP request stores hash only, enforces per-phone/IP rate limits, and is absent in production.

AU-006.note: Single-use OTP verification establishes scoped session and rejects replay/wrong code.

AU-007.note: Bounded attempts and cooldowns prevent OTP brute force without phone enumeration.

AU-008.note: Concurrent OTP challenges honor only the current active challenge once.

AU-009.note: Logout revokes session token immediately and blocks subsequent mutations.

AU-010.note: Users list and revoke only their own sessions.

AU-011.note: Role assignment restricted to platform_admin with audit trail.

AU-012.note: Suspending a member revokes active sessions and blocks API/offline scan sync.

AU-013.note: Isolated preview mode enforces server-side role allowlist and gate.

AU-014.note: External SMS carrier provider is not integrated; fake OTP surface refuses to run in production.

AU-015.note: Same phone across Org A and Org B cannot cross-read orders or sessions.

AU-017.note: Public guest tracking returns identical 404 on wrong phone vs missing order and leaks no PII.

AU-018.note: Mobile/desktop UI verified with Russian labels and accessible auth flow.

CU-001.note: Customer onboarding and first order flow executed end-to-end in Playwright.

CU-002.note: Customer address book CRUD isolated strictly to own customerId.

CU-004.note: Economy weight-based quote, rounding, and bag intake verified.

CU-005.note: Protected item-by-item intake, itemized QC, and exact-set delivery verified.

CU-006.note: Mixed economy bag + protected garment separated and enforced at intake.

CU-008.note: Free shared pickup and delivery windows hold capacity with zero surcharge.

CU-009.note: Individual off-schedule pickup adds explicit surcharge line.

CU-010.note: Individual off-schedule delivery adds separate surcharge line.

CU-011.note: Both off-schedule exceptions produce two unique fee lines without duplication on retry.

CU-012.note: Expired or mismatched quote hash/terms rejected on order creation.

CU-013.note: Concurrent last-slot race and safety_buffer_orders allow exact capacity without oversell.

CU-014.note: Idempotency key replay returns same result; mismatched payload rejected with 409.

CU-015.note: Fake payment capture distinguishes paid invoice from pending_registration fiscal state.

CU-016.note: Printable provisional documents carry explicit non-54-FZ disclaimer and object-level scoping.

CU-017.note: Customer order list and timeline scoped strictly to own orders.

CU-018.note: Atomic two-leg reschedule preserves old holds if second leg fails.

CU-019.note: Cancellation releases held/confirmed capacity and blocks late intake.

CU-021.note: Partner adjustment proposal requires explicit customer consent without forced charge.

CU-022.note: Accepted adjustment binds versioned consent and updates invoice total.

CU-023.note: Declined adjustment leads to return-unprocessed and cancels open invoice.

CU-026.note: Missing/damaged garment claim links garment, places evidence on legal hold, and settles compensation.

CU-027.note: Partial delivery tracks delivered vs missing garments without false full delivery.

CU-029.note: Reviews allowed only for eligible completed orders with audited moderation.

CU-030.note: Support threads scoped to own orders with immutable message history.

CU-032.note: Repeat order prepopulates prior lines while requiring fresh quote and capacity.

CO-001.note: Courier opens and queries own active shift.

CO-003.note: Courier stop list scoped strictly to assigned active stops.

CO-004.note: External geocoding and road-network routing provider not integrated.

CO-005.note: Stop start/arrive transitions enforce assigned courier and optimistic version.

CO-009.note: Active container and seal reuse blocked across orders within tenant; allowed across tenants.

CO-010.note: Economy bag weight recorded with bounds validation and dual confirmation.

CO-011.note: Protected item taxonomy subtype and evidence linked to signed manifest.

CO-012.note: Mixed intake enforces separated economy bag and protected item codes.

CO-013.note: Two-party handoff requires customer/courier confirmation and handoff PIN.

CO-015.note: Device camera permission denial requires physical/emulated camera hardware harness.

CO-018.note: Duplicate offline scan events deduped by clientEventId and payloadHash.

CO-019.note: Suspended courier/device rejected with 401 on subsequent scan sync.

CO-020.note: Partner handoff verifies seal and weight; mismatch or broken seal blocks custody transfer.

CO-021.note: Late intake on cancelled order rejected with 409.

CO-023.note: Delivery requires recipient PIN proof and exact garment set.

CO-024.note: Recipient unavailable keeps custody open and allows repeat delivery attempt.

CO-026.note: Partial delivery records delivered subset without falsely marking order delivered.

CO-028.note: Shift completion reconciles active stops and scan state.

PA-001.note: Partner portal routes enforce partner role and server-bound partnerId.

PA-002.note: Partner inbound receipts restricted to explicitly assigned partner orders.

PA-003.note: Partner B receives 404 on Partner A orders and cannot mutate them.

PA-004.note: Partner receipt matches container/seal manifest before accepting custody.

PA-005.note: Broken seal rejects custody transfer with 409 and persists durable custody_discrepancies row.

PA-006.note: Underweight/overweight variance flags weight_mismatch incident and proposes adjustment.

PA-007.note: Wrong bag/seal at receipt opens discrepancy without transferring custody.

PA-009.note: Partner proposes adjustment or returns order unprocessed without unauthorized substitute work.

PA-010.note: Customer approval advances order to processing and updates invoice.

PA-011.note: Customer refusal enables return-unprocessed and voids open invoice.

PA-013.note: Processing batch restricted to assigned inspected order.

PA-016.note: QC pass transitions order to ready for delivery.

PA-017.note: QC failure returns order to processing for rewash before second QC pass.

PA-022.note: Partner period invoice accrues only own contracted lines.

PA-023.note: Partner disputes own invoice line and finance approves separate credit note.

PA-024.note: Partner operators cannot read platform-wide finance or other partners' accruals.

PA-025.note: Suspended partner staff member loses session immediately.

DI-001.note: Dispatch overview returns tenant-scoped queues and metrics.

DI-003.note: Concurrent bookings cannot oversell window capacity; reconciliation detects drift.

DI-005.note: Dispatcher assigns pickup to active courier shift with state/version checks.

DI-006.note: Dispatcher assigns order to partner before partner receipt is permitted.

DI-008.note: External geocoding and route-matrix optimizer not integrated.

DI-010.note: External routing engine outage fallback requires external routing integration.

DI-015.note: Partner handoff discrepancy opens incident and preserves prior custody holder.

DI-018.note: Partial delivery tracks remaining garments for recovery.

DI-019.note: Recipient unavailable allows dispatcher to schedule repeat delivery.

DI-020.note: Declined adjustment transitions cleanly to return-unprocessed.

DI-024.note: Chronometry and churn metrics computed from persisted domain events.

SU-001.note: Support order search scoped to tenant with minimal contact fields.

SU-002.note: Support threads bind to owned orders with immutable participant trail.

SU-003.note: Support replies enforce participant and tenant isolation.

SU-004.note: Closing support threads requires reason and preserves history.

SU-005.note: Missing-item claim validates order garment ownership and places legal hold on evidence.

SU-006.note: Damage claim retains delivery proof under legal hold during investigation.

SU-008.note: Cross-order/cross-customer evidence IDs rejected and storage keys never exposed.

SU-010.note: Claim decisions require claims_approver/admin role and rationale; customer cannot self-approve.

SU-011.note: Reopening a decided claim preserves prior decision revisions.

SU-012.note: Partial delivery + missing item claim links physical exception with compensation.

SU-013.note: Support proposes compensation; finance separately approves and settles.

SU-016.note: Active legal hold blocks evidence deletion with 409.

SU-019.note: Fraud signals queue surfaces review items without auto-denying claims.

FI-001.note: Finance dashboard/analytics restricted to finance roles and tenant-scoped.

FI-002.note: Customer invoice lines and totals match immutable quote snapshot.

FI-003.note: Fake payment capture posts balanced clearing/advances journal once.

FI-004.note: Duplicate capture with a new key refused with FINANCIAL_HOLD.

FI-005.note: HMAC-SHA256 webhook signature verified and tenant derived from stored intent.

FI-006.note: Retried provider webhook event deduped without extra postings or fiscal rows.

FI-008.note: Two concurrent full refunds serialized via row lock; only one succeeds.

FI-009.note: Chargeback marks intent disputed and blocks subsequent double-payout refund.

FI-012.note: Accepted price adjustment adds consented line to customer invoice.

FI-013.note: Declined adjustment incurs no delta charge and cancels open invoice on return.

FI-014.note: Every ledger journal verified balanced (sum debits === sum credits).

FI-015.note: Customer invoice document carries legal requisites and non-fiscal disclaimer.

FI-016.note: Real 54-FZ KKT/OFD fiscal hardware/provider ACK is not connected; stub stays pending_registration.

FI-017.note: Real 54-FZ KKT/OFD refund/correction receipt requires live fiscal provider.

FI-018.note: Partner accruals derived from signed contract price version and received quantity.

FI-019.note: Disputed partner invoice line resolved via separate credit note approval with balanced journal.

FI-020.note: Partner payout enforces dual-control SoD (creator cannot self-approve) and posts balanced journal.

FI-021.note: Compensation approval and settlement are distinct steps posting claims_expense/clearing.

FI-022.note: Payment drift and reconciliation endpoints expose journal/payment/refund counts.

AD-001.note: Demo login and preview unlock refused in production environment.

AD-002.note: Role grant requires platform_admin and reason with audit trail.

AD-003.note: Role revocation revokes session and last-admin guard holds under concurrency.

AD-004.note: Suspending employee revokes sessions; self-suspension and last-admin lockout refused.

AD-006.note: Admin member listing is tenant-scoped and minimizes sensitive fields.

AD-007.note: Admin session revocation takes immediate effect and is tenant-scoped.

AD-015.note: External KKT/OFD and live acquiring provider credentials are not configured in this repository.

AD-016.note: Fraud queue is read-only review scoped to authorized roles.

AD-017.note: Audit events are append-only, tenant-scoped, and actor/request correlated.

AD-018.note: Evidence access enforces ABAC and never leaks storage keys.

AD-019.note: Off-host backup and clean-instance restore requires external infrastructure host.

AD-020.note: 2x multi-tenant / multi-role negative matrix denies foreign Org A access across 6 roles.

AD-023.note: Privacy export scoped to caller's tenant/user and legal hold blocks held evidence deletion.

OP-001.note: Fresh PostgreSQL migration chain runs cleanly on every test suite boot.

OP-002.note: Upgrade/restore drill verifies populated DB migration preserves orders and ledger.

OP-004.note: Off-host pg_dump/pg_restore or PITR cluster requires external database host.

OP-007.note: Outbox worker retry, backoff, deduplication, and DLQ verified.

OP-008.note: Payment inbox processes events atomically and replays safely.

OP-009.note: Worker concurrency uses FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED and recovers stuck rows.

OP-010.note: Slot holds, expiry, safety buffer, and confirmed-order protection verified in PostgreSQL.

OP-011.note: Cross-tenant isolation verified across orders, finance, claims, evidence, payouts, and privacy export.

OP-012.note: Per-route rate limits and CSRF origin enforcement verified.

OP-013.note: OpenAPI 3.1.0 generated from actual Fastify routes verified for methods, responses, security, and optional params.

OP-014.note: Every frontend api(...) call in apps/web/src verified against mounted backend routes.

OP-015.note: Playwright desktop/mobile smoke and multi-role UI verification scripts exist and pass.

OP-016.note: Offline scan sync deduplication and revoked courier rejection verified.

OP-017.note: Repo hygiene guard blocks PostgreSQL bytes, secrets, media, and oversized blobs.

OP-019.note: Operational metrics, chronometry, churn, and finance drift computed from persisted rows.

F01.note: Full economy building pickup -> partner wash -> QC -> shared delivery -> close verified.

F02.note: Mixed economy bag + protected jacket separation -> itemized QC -> exact-set delivery verified.

F03.note: Both off-schedule exceptional trips produce two unique surcharge lines and one invoice.

F04.note: Concurrent last-slot race allows exactly one customer hold.

F06.note: Atomic two-leg reschedule preserves old holds when second leg fails.

F08.note: Late courier intake on cancelled order rejected with 409.

F09.note: Recipient unavailable keeps custody open and rebooks cleanly.

F10.note: Wrong seal at partner receipt opens discrepancy and refuses custody transfer.

F11.note: Cross-customer active container/seal reuse blocked with 409 CUSTODY_CONFLICT.

F12.note: Partner adjustment accepted by customer updates invoice and advances to processing.

F13.note: Partner adjustment declined leads to return-unprocessed and voids invoice.

F14.note: QC failure returns to processing for rewash; second QC pass reaches ready.

F17.note: Recipient unavailable -> repeat delivery succeeds with PIN proof.

F18.note: Post-delivery claim places legal hold and reopen preserves decision history.

F19.note: Suspended courier rejected on subsequent offline scan sync.

F20.note: Duplicate offline scan events deduped cleanly.

F21.note: Partner B denied access to Partner A's order and mutations.

F22.note: Customer B denied access to Customer A's order, finance, and claim.

F23.note: Two simultaneous full refunds grant only one under row locking.

F24.note: Chargeback and compensation/refund race prevents double payout and preserves balanced ledger.

F25.note: Duplicate signed payment webhook deduped; fiscal receipt stays pending_registration.

F26.note: Partner invoice line dispute + credit note approval preserves history and balances ledger.

F27.note: Support compensation proposal -> finance approval -> settlement verified.

F28.note: Legal hold blocks deletion of held evidence during open claim.

F29.note: Admin role/session revocation takes immediate effect.

F31.note: External routing engine is not integrated.

F33.note: Off-host disaster recovery backup/destroy/restore requires external PostgreSQL host.

F34.note: Same phone across two tenants cannot cross-read sessions or orders.
